tools.name: search_coverage
tools.description: Find BlackRyde.ca pages for a city, airport, venue, event, service or topic. Returns titles, summaries and URLs.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Return the text of a page on blackryde.ca (Markdown when available). Accepts a full URL or a path.

tools.name: get_booking_options
tools.description: Services, vehicles, coverage, pricing rules, contact channels, the online booker link and booking policies.

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Send a chauffeured transportation request to BlackRyde.ca for the traveller. Only call when the traveller explicitly asked to book. Returns a reference (BRC-XXXXXXX); the team confirms price, vehicle and chauffeur by email or phone. Not confirmed until then; nothing is charged.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.php" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_coverage, get_page · Private data: get_booking_options · Public sink: request_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_coverage, get_page · Private data: get_booking_options · Public sink: request_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
